Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the discovery call this morning — really helpful to understand Acme's ingestion and moderation concerns. Quick recap:
- Goal: reduce moderation latency and costs for real-time chat (peak 2k rps)
- Primary constraints: HIPAA-like retention requirements, private VPC option preferred
- Success metric: latency < 200ms p50 on responses and 40% reduction in token cost vs current setup

Next recommended step: a technical demo + deep dive with our Solutions Engineer to walk through architecture, latency profile, and quantization/hosting options. I pulled a couple of times below — if any of these work, I'll lock it and send a calendar invite. Because you mentioned tight timelines, I can prioritize weekday morning slots: 

Option A: Wed, Mar 11 — 10:00–11:00 PT
Option B: Thu, Mar 12 — 09:30–10:15 PT
Option C: Fri, Mar 13 — 08:30–09:15 PT

If none of these work, please send 2x 30–45 min windows that do and I'll match them. I've attached a one-pager on our runtime and a mutual action plan draft for your procurement team.

Attachments: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf, acme-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks,
